ceo.name: Timothy M. Archer
ceo.title: President and Chief Executive Officer
ceo.background: Joined Lam via Novellus Systems acquisition in 2012. 18-year tenure at Novellus prior, serving as COO and various leadership roles including EVP of PECVD and Electrofill Business Units, VP of Worldwide Sales/Marketing/Customer Satisfaction, and Senior Director of Technology for Novellus Systems Japan. Started career at Tektronix in 1989 developing processes for high-speed bipolar ICs.
ceo.education: B.S. Applied Physics from California Institute of Technology (Caltech); Program for Management Development at Harvard Graduate School of Business
ceo.track_record: During CEO tenure, drove revenue growth >50% and EPS increase >85%.
ceo.other_roles: Board of Directors member at Johnson Controls International since 2024

cfo.name: Douglas R. Bettinger
cfo.title: Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer
cfo.background: Prior to Lam: SVP & CFO of Avago Technologies Ltd. Also held executive finance positions at Xilinx, 24/7 Customer, and Intel Corp.
cfo.education: MBA in Finance from University of Michigan; B.S. Economics from University of Wisconsin-Madison
cfo.responsibilities: Finance, tax, treasury, investor relations, corporate analytics
